title: Export report as PDF/CSV
description: Let the warden export the monthly report to a file via the system share sheet / SAF.
acceptanceCriteria: Export produces a readable PDF or CSV with the same numbers as the on-screen report

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

DESIGN.md section 4.6 explicitly marks this 'Phase 2', and it's Low priority, but the AC only asks for 'a readable PDF or CSV' - CSV alone satisfies that in full, so built the smaller of the two rather than deferring: an export icon in MonthlyReportScreen's app bar (only shown once a hostel is active) opens the standard SAF CreateDocument('text/csv') picker; the CSV is built directly from MonthlyReportViewModel's existing uiState (hostel, month, year, totalCollected, totalDues, occupancy%, totalExpense, netIncome) - the exact same numbers already reconciled and shown on screen for LODGY-22, so there's no separate query path that could drift out of sync (AC holds by construction). Row labels reuse existing localized string resources (LODGY-30) so the CSV comes out in whichever language the app is currently set to; amounts are formatted with Locale.US/%.2f deliberately regardless of app language, since a locale-dependent decimal separator would silently corrupt the comma-delimited CSV. No PDF generation was built - not needed to satisfy the AC, and skipping it keeps this appropriately small for a Low-priority, explicitly-Phase-2 item; flagging in case Product Owner specifically wants a PDF later. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still blocked (session-wide emulator limitation, most recently reconfirmed this round) - worth opening the exported CSV in a real spreadsheet app to confirm it parses cleanly.

PASS - AC confirmed on-device with a real number reconciliation. Opened Monthly Report for Sunrise PG Boys, Month=9/Year=2026 (Rs.0 collected, Rs.4000 dues, 14% occupancy, Rs.2950 expense, -Rs.2950 net), tapped the export icon: the standard SAF CreateDocument picker opened with a sensible pre-filled name (lodgy-report-9-2026.csv), saved to Downloads. Pulled the file via adb and its contents are: Hostel=Sunrise PG Boys, Month=9, Year=2026, Total collected=0.00, Total dues=4000.00, Occupancy=14%, Total Expense=2950.00, Income - expense=-2950.00 - every field matches the on-screen report exactly, satisfying the AC in full. File is well-formed (quoted key/value CSV rows, stable 2-decimal amount formatting) and opened/parsed without issue via a plain file read. No PDF was built, which is fine per the AC's 'PDF or CSV' wording and the developer's explicit Phase-2 scoping note.
